title: phlomis majkopensis
intro: Phlomis majkopensis, commonly known as Balkan phlomis, is a plant species belonging to the Lamiaceae family, native to the Balkan Peninsula. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, providing health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects, which can help alleviate various health issues. The therapeutic actions of Phlomis majkopensis include its ability to modulate the immune system, exhibit anti-cancer properties, and act as a neuroprotective agent. The bioactive constituents responsible for its medicinal properties include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and diterpenoids, which are present in its leaves and flowers.
